identity_limitation: normalize_sec_company_facts has no expected-CIK argument; it copies response CIK into source_id. No additional actual cross-issuer FeatureRecord consumption established in this review.
scope_decision: Current producer/backfill/Signal repair may proceed without silently redefining this date-only public interface. If reused for precise-instant research, add explicit identity/availability handling under its owning contract; do not assume next-day/day-end semantics.
